description: Fetch one LinkedIn job posting by its id or URL: title, company, location, employment_type, seniority_level, salary where the posting shows one, and the full description — the fields linkedin/jobs leaves null, and workplace_type, listed_at and easy_apply where the posting shows them. Use it on the job_id of a search result. Give exactly one of `id` or `url`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

id.description: LinkedIn's numeric id for the posting: `job_id` in a search result, and the number at the end of `/jobs/view/…`.

name: get_linkedin_job
title: Get one LinkedIn job posting in full
